name: craft
description: /craft:setup prepares lint with limits. /craft:craft enforces the root rule (less code is better than more code), triages SOLID, KISS, YAGNI, DRY, and Clean Code, and loads only the skill of each principle with a signal. /craft:atdd runs the 7-step flow. /craft:hook turns a correction into a project hook. /craft:memory keeps long-term memory in .claude/memory/, inside the repo. Hooks require the flow before code, English code with user-facing text through i18n, data-testid on every interactive component element, tests without .skip or .only, E2E only in a container, tests always with a filter, and, without CI, the answer of the user about the full suite before a push or a PR/MR. They inject the triage when the suite turns green. They load in every session the writing in the ASD-STE100 standard, the project memory, the tasks with a goal, and the posture of Claude as the tool of the user (the meta-goal Stop hook holds the end of the turn until the goal is closed). They deny memory outside the project.
